h1: Lamoon Boutique Hotel — a small in-town boutique so quiet you sleep right through
intro: Some nights you want to stay in Suphan Buri town but not in a big, crowded block hotel · Lamoon Boutique Hotel is a small guesthouse-style stay on Malai Maen Road with just 9 rooms — and guests agree on what makes it work: peace and quiet, privacy, clean rooms, strong showers and comfortable beds, from around ฿720/night · not a luxury hotel, but it offers the warm, homely feel of a good guesthouse that's hard to find in this town.

body.html: Lamoon Boutique Hotel sits on Malai Maen Road in Rua Yai, Mueang Suphan Buri — in town, within walking distance of restaurants and markets · It's a small boutique building with just 9 rooms, split into Standard (queen bed), Twin (two singles) and Family for larger groups · That low room count is exactly why it feels quieter and more private than a typical hotel, the thing reviewers like most.

Rooms earn praise for being clean and warmly decorated in a boutique style · Every room has AC, a flat-screen TV, an en-suite bathroom and basic toiletries · What guests highlight again and again is the strong shower and the comfortable bed — small things on paper, but they genuinely make a one-night stay better · The rooms aren't huge, in keeping with an in-town boutique, but they're tidy and don't feel cramped.
"Clean room, strong water pressure, comfy bed, lovely and quiet so I slept right through. There's parking too and the staff are sweet — great value."

Parking is another big plus for self-drive travellers · The hotel has free parking, which isn't easy to find in the town centre · The front-desk staff are praised as friendly and attentive, with an easy check-in · The overall feel is more like staying at a friend's place than a hotel, which makes solo travellers and couples feel right at home.

Worth knowing before you book: there's no lift and breakfast is not included · If you land an upper-floor room with heavy bags, be ready to carry them · For breakfast you'll head out, which isn't really a problem since you're in town with rice shops and cafés all around · And with so few rooms, it fills up fast on long weekends or when there's an event in town — book ahead.

Lamoon's location suits people coming to sightsee or run errands in Suphan Buri town · You can walk to the restaurant area, and it's a short drive to the Banharn-Jamsai Tower, Wat Pa Lelai and Kao Hong Market · If your plan is to use the town as a base and then drive out to Sam Chuk Market or Bueng Chawak the next day, it's a convenient and affordable starting point.

The honest verdict, compiled from real guest reviews: Lamoon Boutique Hotel is a small in-town boutique that nails the basics with a strong sense of privacy — clean, quiet, strong showers, good beds, free parking, friendly staff · You do have to accept no lift, no breakfast, and few rooms that book up at peak times · But if you want a reassuring, homely in-town stay at a budget price, it's a satisfying choice.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Lamoon Boutique Hotel Suphan Buri

faq.q: Where is Lamoon Boutique Hotel · is it in Suphan Buri town?
faq.a: It's on Malai Maen Road, Rua Yai, Mueang Suphan Buri — in town, about a 15-20 minute walk to the restaurant area · a short drive to the Banharn Tower and Wat Pa Lelai · It works well as an in-town base before driving out to Sam Chuk Market or Bueng Chawak.

faq.q: How much is Lamoon Boutique Hotel · what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start from around ฿720/night for a Standard queen room · there's also a Standard Twin and a Family room for groups · breakfast is not included · Prices vary by season and platform, so compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Who is Lamoon Boutique Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for couples or anyone wanting a quiet, private in-town stay · a small 9-room boutique with clean rooms, strong showers, comfy beds and free parking · Less ideal if you want full facilities, a pool, or an in-house breakfast.

faq.q: Does the hotel have a lift · is there parking?
faq.a: It's a small boutique with no lift — with heavy bags, ask for a ground-floor room · There is free parking, which is hard to come by in the town centre and a point reviewers praise often.

faq.q: Does Lamoon Boutique Hotel serve breakfast?
faq.a: Breakfast is not included · but since you're in the town centre, there are plenty of rice shops and cafés nearby — it's easy to find a morning spot just a short walk away.
